title.zh: Inkling 2 Mini：可本地运行的开源权重模型
title.en: Inkling 2 Mini: Open-Weight Model for Local Use

excerpt.zh: Inkling 2 Mini 是一款约 20GB、面向本地运行的开源权重模型。其循环式 Transformer 在多项智能体编码和工具使用基准上表现突出，但模型报告的成绩仍需结合评测设置理解。
excerpt.en: Inkling 2 Mini is an open-weight model with an approximately 20GB footprint for local use. Its looping design posts strong results on several agentic coding and tool-use benchmarks, though scores need to be read in

text.zh: Thinking Machines Lab 发布了 Inkling 2 Mini，一款面向本地运行的开源权重模型。它采用循环式 Transformer：每生成一个 token，模型会重复运行中间层三次，试图用更少的输出 token 完成更长的内部计算。
text.en: Thinking Machines Lab has released Inkling 2 Mini, an open-weight model designed for local use. It uses a looped transformer: for each generated token, the model runs its middle layers three times, aiming to do more internal computation with fewer output tokens.

text.zh: Inkling 2 Mini 主打编码与工具使用
text.en: Inkling 2 Mini targets coding and tool use

text.zh: 该模型共有 264 亿参数，每个 token 激活约 34 亿参数；权重主要以 NVFP4 格式训练和部署，报告的总内存占用约为 20GB。发布方称，它在 DeepSWE v1.1、BrowseComp 和 DeepSearchQA 等测试中领先多个同规模开源权重模型，并可在笔记本电脑等设备本地运行。
text.en: The model has 26.4 billion total parameters, with about 3.4 billion active per token. Most weights are trained and deployed in NVFP4, and the reported memory footprint is around 20GB. The company says Inkling 2 Mini leads several similarly sized open-weight models on tests including DeepSWE v1.1, BrowseComp, and DeepSearchQA, and can run locally on devices such as laptops.

text.zh: 循环设计的价值不只是跑分。Thinking Machines 报告称，在研究用的可变循环版本中，增加循环次数改善了部分长程推理表现；思维链变短但仍保持可读。不过，更多循环并未提升知识密集型测试成绩，模型对事实的掌握仍主要受参数规模限制。
text.en: The looping design is relevant beyond benchmark scores. Thinking Machines reports that, in a research variant with a variable number of loops, additional passes improved some long-horizon reasoning results. Its chain of thought became shorter but remained legible. More passes did not improve knowledge-intensive tests, however; factual knowledge remains largely tied to parameter count.

text.zh: 评测成绩仍需谨慎解读
这些结果来自模型发布方披露的评测，且不同模型的测试设置并不完全一致，因此不能仅凭排行榜推断日常效果。循环次数与可监控性的实验也来自研究版本，不能直接等同于所有部署场景。开放权重和较小内存占用降低了试用门槛；实际表现仍取决于硬件、工具配置与任务，独立复现将有助于验证其优势。
text.en: These results come from the model publisher, and evaluation setups differ across models, so a leaderboard alone cannot establish everyday performance. Experiments on loop count and monitorability also used a research variant and may not directly reflect every deployment. Open weights and a modest memory footprint make testing more accessible, but results in practice will depend on hardware, tool configuration, and task; independent replication would help establish how robust the reported advantages are.
